description.base: Moonlight spills through a cracked skylight onto black-and-white tiles. Dust drifts like slow snow.

variants.text: Four pale blue flames burn on the candelabra. A seam in the wall has opened onto a dark corridor.

exits.label: Hidden door
exits.lockedText: A seam in the wall holds fast. The candelabra seems to be watching it.

hotspots.label: Front door
hotspots.semanticLabel: Front door, sealed
hotspots.description: The door you came through has sealed itself. Frost traces the keyhole. Whatever lives here wants you to stay and listen.

hotspots.label: Portrait of Ottoline
hotspots.semanticLabel: Portrait of a woman with ink-stained fingers
hotspots.description: A woman with ink-stained fingers smiles from the frame. The plaque reads: 'Listen twice.' A brass key hangs from the corner of the frame.
hotspots.repeatText: Ottoline's painted eyes look amused. 'Listen twice,' says the plaque.

hotspots.label: Silver candelabra
hotspots.semanticLabel: Silver candelabra with four unlit candles
hotspots.description: Four cold candles stand in a silver branch, each etched with a moon: crescent, half, full, waning.

repeatText.base: Four cold candles wait in the silver branch, each etched with a moon.

variants.text: The four candles burn with a pale blue flame that casts no heat.

hotspots.label: Dormant automaton
hotspots.semanticLabel: Tall clockwork porter standing motionless
hotspots.description: A tall clockwork porter in a faded coat stands motionless. A winding slot gleams between his shoulder blades.

repeatText.base: The clockwork porter stands motionless. A winding slot gleams in his back.

variants.text: Tallow stands at attention, a little stiff. 'I was told to hurry, sir. I am hurrying.'
Tallow ticks softly. 'The library lies beyond the candlelit door. Mind the dark.'

hotspots.label: Hall table
hotspots.semanticLabel: Hall table with a guest ledger
hotspots.description: A guest ledger lies open. The last entry is in your own handwriting: 'Arrived. The manor is listening.' You do not remember writing it.
hotspots.repeatText: The ledger's last line has not changed. The ink looks wet.

description.base: Shelves climb into darkness. Somewhere above you, pages turn by themselves.

variants.text: Lantern light shows shelves of warped leather and a reading desk under a green glass lamp.

exits.label: Shelf passage
exits.lockedText: Only books and solid wall. One shelf seems to be whispering a word.

hotspots.label: Reading desk
hotspots.semanticLabel: Reading desk under a green lamp
hotspots.lockedText: It is too dark to see more than the outlines of shelves. Perhaps the caretaker has a light.
hotspots.description: Ottoline's journal lies open under the lamp. The last entry is underlined twice. You take it.
hotspots.repeatText: A clean ring on the desk shows where the journal sat.

hotspots.label: Whispering shelf
hotspots.semanticLabel: Bookshelf with letters stamped on the spines
hotspots.lockedText: It is too dark to see more than the outlines of shelves. Perhaps the caretaker has a light.
hotspots.description: Six books are pulled halfway out. Their spines are stamped O, L, V, W, H, Q. A brass plate says: 'Step back, and the shelf will speak.'

repeatText.base: Six books stand pulled out, stamped O, L, V, W, H, Q.

variants.text: The shelf has folded aside, leaving a narrow passage that smells of copper and rain.

hotspots.label: Cold hearth
hotspots.semanticLabel: Cold stone hearth full of ash
hotspots.lockedText: It is too dark to see more than the outlines of shelves. Perhaps the caretaker has a light.
hotspots.description: Under the ash you find half a page, the edge singed. Chemical symbols march across it. You take it.
hotspots.repeatText: Only cold ash remains. Whoever burned the page missed one half.

hotspots.label: Ink blotter
hotspots.semanticLabel: Ink blotter with space for two torn pages
hotspots.lockedText: It is too dark to see more than the outlines of shelves. Perhaps the caretaker has a light.
hotspots.description: A blotter large enough to lay out a letter. Two pale rectangles on it are the size of torn pages.

repeatText.base: A blotter with two pale rectangles the size of torn pages.

variants.text: The blotter is stained with a finished recipe. You have already mixed what it describes.

hotspots.label: Investor's ledger
hotspots.semanticLabel: Ledger stamped E. Maul
hotspots.lockedText: It is too dark to see more than the outlines of shelves. Perhaps the caretaker has a light.
hotspots.description: A ledger stamped E. MAUL, INVESTOR. Past the figures is a note: 'Once the Echo can be bottled, it can be sold. O. is a sentimental fool.'
hotspots.repeatText: Maul's note is cold and neat. The figures beside it are not.

rooms.name: Alchemist's Workshop
rooms.description: Copper pipes snake across the ceiling above benches crowded with flasks. The air tastes of metal and sugar.

exits.label: Spiral stair
exits.lockedText: A hatch in the ceiling is sealed. The brass tuner on the wall looks like it controls it.

hotspots.label: Crowded bench
hotspots.semanticLabel: Workbench of glowing flasks
hotspots.description: Flasks of green and amber liquid hum faintly. One label reads: 'Never speak near this one.'
hotspots.repeatText: The flasks hum a little louder when you whisper. You stop whispering.

hotspots.label: Corroded cabinet
hotspots.semanticLabel: Cabinet sealed by green corrosion
hotspots.description: A cabinet sealed by green corrosion. The lock has fused into a lump of verdigris.

repeatText.base: The lock is a lump of verdigris. Nothing you carry would cut it.

variants.text: The cabinet hangs open. The lock has dissolved into a green puddle.

hotspots.wrongItemText: That does not touch the corrosion. Whatever opens this must eat metal.

hotspots.label: Brass phonograph
hotspots.semanticLabel: Brass phonograph with an empty spindle
hotspots.description: A phonograph with a horn shaped like a lily. Its spindle is bare.

repeatText.base: The phonograph waits, its spindle bare.

variants.text: The cylinder is still turning. Ottoline's voice hangs in the room like warm breath.

useRules.successText: Ottoline's voice crackles: 'Day ninety. The Echo answers only when the tuning is right. Seven, then three. And remember: water wakes first. If I do not return, Wren, keep Edric away from the core.'

hotspots.label: Resonance tuner
hotspots.semanticLabel: Brass tuning dial with a numbered scale
hotspots.lockedText: The dial is dead. It needs a signal to tune to, and you have none yet.
hotspots.description: A brass dial with a scale from 0 to 99. A needle trembles, waiting for a number.

repeatText.base: The needle trembles, waiting for a number.

variants.text: The needle rests at the tuned number. A hatch above has dropped open.

hotspots.label: Speaking horn
hotspots.semanticLabel: Copper speaking horn bolted to the wall
hotspots.description: A copper horn bolted to the wall. When you lean close, something leans close back.

repeatText.base: The horn is quiet. It is listening.

variants.text: The horn rattles faintly in its bracket. It has not forgotten your tone.

rooms.name: Clocktower Chamber
rooms.description: Great gears turn without a sound behind walls of glass. The moon is a huge pale face in the clock window.

exits.label: Vault drawbridge
exits.lockedText: The drawbridge to the vault is raised. Its drive shaft is missing a gear.

hotspots.label: Great clock face
hotspots.semanticLabel: Great clock with drooping hands and a setting lever
hotspots.description: The great clock's hands droop at the wrong hour. A brass lever lets you set them.

repeatText.base: The hands droop at the wrong hour, waiting for you to set them.

variants.text: The clock case stands open. The hands now show the hour Ottoline vanished.

hotspots.label: Drive gear frame
hotspots.semanticLabel: Frame holding three drive gears, one empty socket
hotspots.description: Three drive gears sit in a frame, one socket empty. Each gear can be turned a notch at a time.

repeatText.base: Three drive gears wait in a frame, one socket empty.

variants.text: The gears mesh smoothly. Far below, a drawbridge groans down.

hotspots.wrongItemText: That does not fit the empty socket. The missing piece is a small cog.

hotspots.label: Keeper's logbook
hotspots.semanticLabel: Logbook from inside the clock case
hotspots.lockedText: A logbook is visible through the clock case glass. The case will not open yet.
hotspots.description: The last line is in Ottoline's hand: 'Edric pulled the core and left the engine cold. I will tune it by voice. Wind always closes the circle. O.V., 11:40.'
hotspots.repeatText: Ottoline's last line is steady. Her handwriting was not afraid.

hotspots.label: Brass speaking tube
hotspots.semanticLabel: Brass speaking tube with a faint voice inside
hotspots.lockedText: The tube is silent. Something is waiting for you to find what the clock hides.
hotspots.description: A brass tube curls from the wall. A smooth voice slides out of it as you approach.

repeatText.base: The tube is silent. It is thinking.

variants.text: The tube whispers your own promise back to you.

description.base: A round chamber of mirrored stone. Every footstep returns a heartbeat late. At its center stands a dormant engine of rings and pillars.

variants.text: The engine hums. Every wall holds a faint reflection of someone who is not there.

hotspots.label: Resonance Engine
hotspots.semanticLabel: Resonance Engine with four pillars: tide, ember, gale and stone
hotspots.description: Four pillars rise from a ring of copper: tide, ember, gale and stone. An empty cradle waits for a crystal.

repeatText.base: Four pillars wait around an empty cradle.

variants.text: The engine hums, steady and patient. It is waiting for an answer.

hotspots.wrongItemText: The cradle is shaped for a crystal, and this is not one.

hotspots.label: The Echo
hotspots.semanticLabel: A faint shimmer in the air at the center of the vault
hotspots.lockedText: Something shimmers above the engine, too faint to hear. The engine is still cold.
hotspots.description: The shimmer gathers into a voice that sounds like Ottoline's. It waits for you.
hotspots.repeatText: The Echo waits. It is patient in the way of things that have already lost.

hotspots.label: Mirrored wall
hotspots.semanticLabel: Mirrored stone wall that reflects late

description.base: Your reflection lifts its hand a moment after you do. Behind it, someone smaller in a long coat watches.

variants.text: Your reflection lifts its hand late. Behind it a tall figure in a fine coat watches, then looks away.

hotspots.repeatText: The reflection waits a heartbeat to copy you. The figure behind it does not copy anything.
